thresholds.method: Daily means of hourly CAMS dust/AOD and ERA5 wind/RH for Gombe (10.29N, 11.17E), harmattan months Nov-Mar only. Empirical percentiles feed a weighted index; level cuts are composite percentiles 50/75/90.

sources.name: NASA POWER — MERRA-2 AOD & GEOS-IT meteorology
sources.role: Harmattan climatology, percentile thresholds, NASA seasonal baseline

sources.name: CAMS global atmospheric composition (via Open-Meteo)
sources.role: Live dust concentration, AOD and the 3-day outlook

sources.name: NASA GIBS / Worldview
sources.role: MODIS true colour, Deep Blue AOD and OMI UV aerosol imagery

sources.name: AERONET — Ilorin, Nigeria
sources.role: Ground-truth AOD used to validate the reanalysis

sources.name: MODIS MAIAC & VIIRS Deep Blue AOD
sources.role: Documented satellite validation track (not required for the demo)

disclaimer.en: General guidance from a dust forecast, not medical advice.

nasa_latest.note: MERRA-2 aerosol products lag real time; NASA POWER supplies the climatology and seasonal baseline rather than today's value.
